{{Top|leg}}
An '''electromagnetic field receptor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. The [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was equipped with such a device among his varied long-range sensor array.
